items.title: System Preferences
items.description: Define settings that impact the Rent Manager features available and how they work for all users.

items.title: System Web Preferences
items.description: Control the content and display of Tenant Web Access, Owner Web Access, Online Applications, and more.

items.title: Personal Preferences
items.description: Customize display, search, and email settings for your Rent Manager user account only.

items.title: Asset Types
items.description: Create categories to classify different kinds of assets created in Rent Manager.

items.title: Asset Manufacturers
items.description: Define manufacturers to assign assets you manage. Maintain contact information of each manufacturer.

items.title: Asset Statuses
items.description: Create categories to apply to assets that describe the condition or current position in your asset workflow.

items.title: Asset Tile Statuses
items.description: Define categories to apply to assets that describe the current state of an asset’s title.

items.title: Asset Workflow
items.description: Create custom workflows to move an asset through available statuses.

items.title: Unit to Asset Conversion Wizard
items.description: Convert items that were previously set up as units to assets in Rent Manager.

items.title: Homeowner Statuses & Site Classifications
items.description: Customize homeowner statuses and their corresponding site classifications.

items.title: Lead Sources
items.description: Define available lead sources to track how prospects are finding your available units.

items.title: Owner Prospect Lead Sources
items.description: Define available lead sources to track how owners are finding your management company.

items.title: Contact Types
items.description: Create categories that can be assigned to tenant, prospect, or vendor contacts for easy identification.

items.title: Account Groups
items.description: Manage existing tenant account groups. Update the master account, remove tenant from a group, or delete the entire group.

items.title: History Categories
items.description: Create tags to assign to History/Notes to help filter, search, and share notes.

items.title: Lease Terms
items.description: Define default lease duration that can be selected when adding or renewing tenant leases.

items.title: Lease Term Adjustment Tool
items.description: Update the lease terms on multiple existing leases at once.

items.title: Month to Month Adjustment Tool
items.description: Use this tool to set the lease term to MTM for leases with start dates or expired leases with no move out date.

items.title: Prospect Stages
items.description: Define stages through which your prospects progress and assign triggers to automatically move them through the process.

items.title: Lost Reasons
items.description: Customize the list of available reasons a prospect is marked as lost to help standardize reporting.

items.title: Pet Types
items.description: Define the different pets allowed at your properties and set custom charge and deposit amounts for each.

items.title: Property Groups
items.description: Group multiple properties together to easily select them for posting, reporting, and filtering.

items.title: Floors
items.description: Create and manage the names of floors available in your properties. Floors are added to units to provide detailed information about a unit’s location.

items.title: Amenities
items.description: Add or manage features available at your rental units. These can be assigned to units and used to help match prospects to a unit.

items.title: Assign Amenities
items.description: Assign applicable amenities to properties and units to help match prospects to the perfect space.

items.title: Subsidies
items.description: Manage subsidy types offered to your tenants. Define the program from which payment is received and the charge type to which the payment can apply.

items.title: Unit Status Types
items.description: Customize the statuses available for your units. Control if units show as vacant and/or available for each status.

items.title: Association Committees
items.description: Add and manage committees for you Homeowner Association properties. Tenants can be assigned to a committee via the property’s Association tab.

items.title: Violation Categories
items.description: Define and manage labels to organize violation codes and group them together.

items.title: Violation Code Groups
items.description: Create code groups to organize violation categories and violation codes together.

items.title: STR Payment Policies
items.description: Establish rules for when the balance of an STR reservation is due. Set the amount due at booking and when any remaining balance will be due from the guest.

items.title: STR Promotions
items.description: Create promotion codes guests can use to redeem a discount when making a reservation.

items.title: Eviction Workflows
items.description: Manage tenant eviction workflows and customize eviction stages.

items.title: Eviction Reasons
items.description: Customize the list of available reasons a tenant is marked as evicted to help in reporting the eviction process.

items.title: Eviction Outcomes
items.description: Define the different outcomes for the eviction process to help track the tenants that are evicted and not evicted.

items.title: Beginning Balances
items.description: Enter the balances of your general ledger accounts as of the day prior to using Rent Manager.

items.title: Tax Types
items.description: Define tax rates and the charge types to which they can be applied on your invoices.

items.title: Terms
items.description: Customize the selectable terms on bills to quickly set due dates based on the date of the bill.

items.title: CPI
items.description: Record adjustments to the Consumer Price Index that can be applied when batch modifying recurring charges or market rents.

items.title: Budget
items.description: Create or import budgets by property or add comments to existing budgets.

items.title: Forecast Models
items.description: Enter assumptions about GL accounts and future occupancy that can be used to project future earnings and expenses.

items.title: Vendor 1099 Adjustment Tool
items.description: Quickly find and update multiple checks that have the incorrect 1099 status selected.

items.title: Job Types
items.description: Create categories to classify different kinds of jobs created in Rent Manager.

items.title: Accounting Periods
items.description: Create accounting periods to allow certain reports to run by the established period.

items.title: Bank Sync Setup
items.description: Connect your online banking to a Rent Manager general ledger account to sync transactions for reconciliation.

items.title: Manage Aliases
items.description: Control the content and display of Tenant Web Access, Owner Web Access, Online Applications, and more.

items.title: Owner Groups
items.description: Group multiple owners together to easily select them for posting, reporting, and filtering.

items.title: Purchase Order Workflows
items.description: Specify the order of tasks and users assigned to reviewing, approving, and fulfilling a PO.

items.title: Digital Signatures
items.description: Upload images of handwritten signatures that can be saved and printed on checks.

items.title: Positive Pay Formats
items.description: Create and assign templates for your bank's Positive Pay file structure to send check details to your bank prior to checks being cashed.

items.title: Memorized Comments
items.description: Create custom messages that can be quickly inserted into the comment field on invoices and statements.

items.title: Allocation Order
items.description: Set the order in which charge types are paid when a payment is recorded.

items.title: Rentable Security Deposit Management
items.description: Streamline deposit collection, ensure total compliance with legislation, and offer tenants flexible payment options.

items.title: Priorities
items.description: Create and color code the priority levels that are selectable on service issues.

items.title: Issue Categories
items.description: Customize and color code categories used to classify your service issues.

items.title: Statuses
items.description: Define and color code issue statuses used to track progress of your service issues.

items.title: Maintenance Techs
items.description: Designate users as maintenance techs to manage work schedules and time off. A tech's workload can be managed using the Maintenance Schedule.

items.title: Maintenance Groups
items.description: Define the team of technicians servicing specific properties and the days and time blocks they are available for scheduling. These groups allow you to easily manage your maintenance scheduling.

items.title: Make Ready Actions
items.description: Manage the available categories for issues and inspections in your make ready process. These actions are column headers to organize your make ready board.

items.title: Community Calendar Event Types
items.description: Create labels and define colors that can be used to categorize the different events offered in your community.

items.title: Meter Estimates
items.description: Set default values for estimate limits and estimation methods.

items.title: High / Low Settings
items.description: Set how flagged meter readings are reviewed, define exception reasons, and choose if approvals are needed before posting charges.

items.title: Users
items.description: Create and manage Rent Manager user accounts. Assign privileges, roles, reports, letters, dashboards, and menus.

items.title: User Roles
items.description: Establish privileges, reports, letters, dashboard, and menu settings that can be applied to multiple users who share the same job.

items.title: Merge Users
items.description: Combine duplicate Rent Manager user accounts into a single user record.

items.title: Manage Rent Manager Sessions
items.description: View all currently logged in Rent Manager users and log off users as needed.

items.title: Colors
items.description: Define custom display colors for Rent Manager records such as tenants, owners, prospects, tasks, and more.

items.title: My Layouts
items.description: Customize the way information is displayed on entity detail pages, including tenants, prospects, issues, and more.

items.title: System Layouts
items.description: Customize the way information is displayed on entity detail pages, including tenants, prospects, issues, and more.

items.title: My Dashboards
items.description: Design and manage dashboards for your Rent Manager user account.

items.title: System Dashboards
items.description: Create and manage dashboards that can be shared with and assigned to other Rent Manager users.

items.title: Scoreboards
items.description: Create and manage scoreboards that can be assigned to other Rent Manager users.

items.title: Image Types
items.description: Create categories to classify and assign to property, unit, unit type, and asset images.

items.title: Manage Text Numbers
items.description: Control which numbers are available for broadcasts, Automated Notifications, AR Automation, and individual texts.

items.title: Manage Web hooks
items.description: Create webhooks to send information from your database to a secure web address when an event occurs in Rent Manager.

items.title: User Defined Fields
items.description: Manage custom fields to track information that Rent Manager doesn't track by default.

items.title: System UDF Values
items.description: Add or update the data stored in your system-level user defined fields.

items.title: System Filters
items.description: Create and assign custom filters that make it easier to find what you need in Rent Manager.

items.title: Guest Card Templates
items.description: Create and manage the questions that appear on your guest cards and how they are mapped to fields in Rent Manager.

items.title: Unit Migration Wizard
items.description: Move units from one property to another. This will move all transactions associated with the unit as well.

items.title: Online Template Library
items.description: Download templates for letters, reports, and inspections that can then be modified to meet your exact needs.

items.title: Address Types
items.description: Define categories for the different addresses stored on each of your entities in Rent Manager.

items.title: Phone Number Types
items.description: Define categories for the different phone numbers stored on each of your entities in Rent Manager.

items.title: Custom Add Wizards
items.description: Design your own add wizards with just the fields you need for adding prospects, moving tenants in/out, creating assets, and more.

items.title: Posting Rollback
items.description: Reverse postings such as recurring charges, reconciliations, imports, late fees, and more.

items.title: Automated Notifications
items.description: Send customized emails and texts automatically based on events in Rent Manager or set schedules.

items.title: Manage Import Templates
items.description: View details of, rename, or delete existing import templates.

items.title: Available Integrations
items.description: Browse available Rent Manager integrations with our partners and directly request activation.

items.title: My Integrations
items.description: Review your active integrations. Find contact information for vendors, deactivate, or modify associated settings.

items.title: Manage Locations
items.description: Add, edit, delete, or switch to additional database locations.

items.title: Change Locations
items.description: Switch to a different database location.
